app.name: ReBona
app.tagline: A few questions about your health, and what to do next
disclaimer.short: This is a screening aid, not a diagnosis.
disclaimer.full: ReBona helps you understand your risk for conditions like high blood pressure and diabetes. It cannot diagnose anything. Whatever your result, a clinic visit is the only way to know for certain.
onboarding.privacy: No name, no phone number, no email. Your answers stay on this device unless you choose otherwise.
progress.label: Question {current} of {total}
q.tobacco_current.label: Do you currently smoke or use any tobacco?
q.tobacco_frequency.label: How often?
q.tobacco_past.label: Have you used tobacco in the past?
q.tobacco_past.opt.quit_over_year: Stopped more than a year ago
q.alcohol_frequency.label: How often do you drink alcohol?
q.alcohol_heavy.label: In the last month, how often did you have six or more drinks in one sitting?
q.alcohol_heavy.help: One drink means a standard bottle of beer, a glass of wine, or a shot of spirits.
q.diet_fruit_veg.label: On a normal day, how many servings of fruit or vegetables do you eat?
q.diet_fruit_veg.help: One serving is roughly what fits in your cupped hand.
q.diet_salt.label: How often do you add salt to food at the table?
q.diet_processed.label: How often do you eat fried or packaged food?
q.activity_days.label: In a normal week, how many days do you do something that leaves you out of breath?
q.activity_days.help: Walking quickly, farming, carrying loads, sport, or hard housework all count.
q.activity_sitting.label: On a normal day, how many hours do you spend sitting?
q.history_family.label: Has a parent, brother, or sister ever had any of these?
q.history_diagnosed.label: Has a health worker ever told you that you have any of these?
q.bp_systolic.label: Do you know your blood pressure?
q.bp_systolic.help: Enter the top number only. Skip this if you have not had it measured.
q.height_cm.label: How tall are you?
q.weight_kg.label: How much do you weigh?
q.symptoms_recent.label: Have you noticed any of these in the last few weeks?
q.symptoms_recent.opt.excessive_thirst: Feeling thirsty much more than usual
q.symptoms_recent.opt.frequent_urination: Passing urine much more than usual
q.symptoms_recent.opt.numbness: Numbness or tingling in hands or feet
q.symptoms_recent.opt.slow_healing: Cuts that are slow to heal
result.title.low: Your risk looks low right now
result.title.moderate: There are some things worth watching
result.body.low: Nothing in your answers points to raised risk today. Screening again in a year is a good habit, and sooner if anything changes.
result.body.moderate: Some of your answers point to risk that builds slowly. None of it is urgent, and most of it responds well to small changes. A clinic can measure your blood pressure and blood sugar directly.
result.body.high: Several answers together suggest you would benefit from being seen. This does not mean you are ill. It means a clinician should measure rather than estimate.
urgent.banner: Please see a health worker soon
urgent.systolic: The blood pressure reading you entered is high enough to need prompt attention.
urgent.symptom_cluster: Several symptoms together are worth having checked without waiting.
assistant.title: Ask about your result
assistant.placeholder: What does high blood pressure mean?
assistant.grounded_note: Answers come from a small set of public health guidance, and questions outside it get no answer rather than a guess.
assistant.no_answer: That is outside what I can answer from the guidance I have. A health worker at your nearest clinic is the right person to ask.
assistant.no_medical_advice: I cannot tell you what treatment to take or change. A clinician has to make that call.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Your answers are saved, so you can carry on from where you stopped.
error.offline: You are offline. Your answers are saved on this device and will send when you reconnect.
empty.history: No screenings yet. The first one takes about three minutes.
